# Mermaid diagram types (auto-generated)

> cached against Mermaid 12.0.0 (tag `mermaid@12.0.0` of mermaid-js/mermaid).
> Source of truth: `packages/mermaid/src/diagrams`. Regenerate with `scripts/refresh.sh`.
> `common` and `error` are omitted: shared code and the syntax-error renderer.
> Per-type catalog files are `reference/catalog/<type>.md`; builders are in `reference/coverage.md`.
